capabilities: Print a note or folder to a single PDF from the file explorer context menu or command palette
Toggle whether each note starts on a new page
Reorder notes in a dialog before printing a folder
Save the PDF into the vault and open the system share sheet
extras: Manual installation only (copy files into the plugins folder); README lists unsupported content: Dataview, Mermaid, embedded PDFs/audio/video/canvas; includes a German summary.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to print multiple notes, or an entire folder, into one combined PDF, especially on mobile.
summary: Prints a note or a whole folder to a single PDF with selectable text, including on Obsidian Mobile (Android).
